description: AstroSpace is a passionate team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are interested in space exploration, research, creativity and innovation. Our project focuses on storytelling about NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. We aim to explore the topic through research, creative ideas and visual communication. We welcome enthusiastic members with skills in research, graphic design, writing, storytelling and multimedia.
summary:
Project Astro Space

Project Astro Space is a digital storytelling project that explores the abandoned equipment and human-made objects left behind on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions. The project aims to highlight the history, purpose, and importance of these objects through informative content and visual storytelling.

It presents how different space missions have used equipment such as landers, rovers, scientific instruments, and other mission hardware, and explains why some of them remain on planetary surfaces after their missions are completed.

By combining space science, historical information, images, and interactive storytelling, Project Astro Space aims to create awareness about humanity's exploration of other worlds. It also encourages people to understand the legacy of past missions and their contribution to future space research.

Our goal is to make space exploration history interesting, educational, and accessible to everyone.
details:
Our project, Astro Space, focuses on exploring abandoned human-made equipment and objects on the Moon and Mars. It aims to create awareness about space exploration history by explaining what equipment has been left behind, why it was abandoned, and how it may affect future space missions.

The project will present information through a simple and interactive digital storytelling platform. Users can explore different abandoned objects, understand their original purposes, learn why they are no longer in use, and discover their importance for future space exploration.

The main benefit of this project is to make space science and planetary exploration easier and more interesting for students and the general public. It also highlights the importance of responsible space exploration and the challenges of managing human-made objects beyond Earth.

We plan to use NASA's publicly available information, images, and educational resources, along with Google Sites for presenting the project. ChatGPT will assist with organizing information and developing project content.

The creative aspect of our project is presenting space exploration history in a simple, educational, and engaging storytelling format. Our team considers scientific accuracy, educational value, user accessibility, environmental awareness, and the future of space exploration.
